title: Generated DBCOLOR OBJECTS allocation rollback and retry
scope: Direct AC1027 DBCOLOR DXF OBJECTS callback under dxfRW::write; one generated color record with an ACAD_COLOR dictionary owner, ASCII and Binary.
implementation: Added tests/dbcolor_objects_allocation_tests.cpp and a focused CTest target. The test sweeps allocation failures through the public dxfRW::writeDbColor API. reserveHandle now records handles reserved during an admitted DXF write as attempt-local allocator state so a failed attempt cannot raise HANDSEED on same-codec retry.

validation.perOffset: one-shot std::bad_alloc; failed write preserves the prior destination and caller DBCOLOR state; same dxfRW codec retry reproduces clean calibration bytes and typed DBCOLOR readback

limits: Generated serializer transaction and typed DXF readback evidence only.
Does not qualify a physical producer, ACAD_COLOR graph semantics, native color-book behavior, DWG output, or broad support.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added; test output uses its build scratch directory.
